comment: Route B background job schedules (slice B5). Each entry becomes one Railway cron service at provisioning time (B6) that POSTs to the Chef service. Schedules are the exact cron expressions the June pg_cron jobs used, in UTC. See docs/railway-jobs.md for how the cron services are built and run.

jobs.idempotency: Skips players with a daily_heartbeat snapshot in the last 20 hours; safe to fire twice.
jobs.name: cybercache-daily-heartbeat

jobs.idempotency: Deletes a fixed predicate (throttled snapshot sources older than 30 days); a second run deletes nothing more.
jobs.name: cybercache-prune-snapshots

onDemand.name: cybercache-seed-npc-market
onDemand.notes: Cold-start / restock of the NPC marketplace. Not scheduled: run once after provisioning (B6) and whenever the NPC stock needs a refresh. Replaces the NPC account's active listings, so re-running is safe. The June endpoint POST /api/market/seed (header x-npc-market-secret, env NPC_MARKET_SEED_SECRET) remains as an alias onto the same store.
